# About
> Rahbars is Pakistan's most detailed university admission platform.
> It provides fee structures, merit lists, admission deadlines, entry test guides,
> aggregate calculators, and counseling for students applying to universities across Pakistan.
> Brand: Rahbars | URL: https://www.rahbars.com

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.rahbars.com/) — Main landing page
- [University Search](https://www.rahbars.com/search) — Browse and filter all universities
- [Merit Calculator](https://www.rahbars.com/merit-calculator) — Calculate aggregate merit score
- [Compare Universities](https://www.rahbars.com/compare) — Side-by-side comparison
- [AI University Finder](https://www.rahbars.com/find-university) — 10-question AI matcher
- [Blog](https://www.rahbars.com/blog) — Admission guides, tips, and entry test prep
- [News](https://www.rahbars.com/news) — Latest admission news and updates
- [Past Papers](https://www.rahbars.com/past-papers) — Entry test past papers download
- [Document Tools](https://www.rahbars.com/document-tools) — Compress/resize documents for upload
- [Counseling](https://www.rahbars.com/counseling) — Book 1-on-1 expert counseling session
- [About](https://www.rahbars.com/about) — About Rahbars
- [Contact](https://www.rahbars.com/contact) — Contact us

## University Profiles
Each university has a dedicated profile at /university/{slug} with:
- Admission deadlines and open/closed status
- Fee structure and fee ranges
- Merit history by year and program
- Entry test details (ECAT, MDCAT, NET, own test)
- Aggregate formula (Matric % + FSc % + Test %)
- Departments and programs offered
- Scholarships available
- HEC recognition status

## Blog Coverage
The blog covers: admission guides, merit calculation, MDCAT, ECAT, NET, aggregate formulas,
university reviews, career guidance, scholarship guides, LUMS, NUST, FAST, NED, UoK,
Habib University, UET, and all major Pakistani universities.
